metadata.title: Kordoi | Assamese Recipe
metadata.description:
Kordoi is a popular snack from the North-Eastern state of Assam. THis is a recipe for the savory  version of Kordoi. This snack can be made with very basic ingredients and doesn't require any special preparations. Kordois can be served with piping hot cup of tea or coffee with sauce or chutneys as side. This dish is specially made during the festival of Bihu.

Ingredients
1 cup Whole Wheat flour/Multi grain flour/All Purpose Floor (maida)
2 tsp Ghee
1/2 tsp Turmeric Powder
2 tbsp Chopped Onion
2 tbsp Chopped Coriander
2 tbsp Grated Carrot
1/2 tsp Cumin Seeds
1/2 tsp Carrom Seeds
Salt as per taste
Oil for deep fry
Water as required
